action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Check docs/kiro-process.md for a dated entry that covers this task (matching its title or scope). If an entry already exists, do nothing. If it is missing, append a new dated entry following the process-log.md steering rules: next sequence number, date, what was asked, what Kiro did, files changed, time taken, what went wrong or surprised you, and what was learned. Then stage docs/kiro-process.md, commit with a clear message naming the task, and push. Never skip the entry.
